confirmed: One provider: Continue with single sign-on is a single button that starts the provider directly (login.tsx methods.ssoProviderId branch).

Single sign-on is not configured yet message still renders when the Legal policy has SSO on and no provider is registered (login.tsx ssoUnconfigured). Only reachable through the legacy unsaved-policy fallback now, because PATCH refuses SSO without a provider and removing the last provider turns SSO off (authentication-policy-routes.ts, routes.ts).

Administrator sign-in appears in the SSO and sign-in link views for the Legal page when Legal password is off; a Legal Team Member gets Password sign-in is disabled for this account. (login.tsx; instance.ts assertPasswordSignIn and session create hook).
Sign-in link rules unchanged: five-minute single-use link, neutral Check your email, three requests per email in 15 minutes (login.tsx magicSent body; limits.ts only adds a setup-token bucket).

Password lockout, password setup link and its one-hour expiry, and the two-factor and session sections: no source change since 067c1646 in two-factor.tsx, two-factor-enroll.tsx, settings-profile.tsx, set-password.tsx, link-expired.tsx, magic-link-request.tsx, user-menu.tsx, app-header.tsx.
Sign-out: session.ts only adds clearSetupDrafts after sign-out; the Sign out behavior the guide describes is unchanged.
limitations: The several-provider path needs two registered identity providers on the lab (the admin-org oidc-fixture can serve this). The unavailable-page path needs the last provider removed while SSO is the only Legal method; the walkthrough must keep an Administrator session in another context to restore a method.

confirmed: Business page title Business Portal sign-in; Get a sign-in link, Send link, Check your email neutral body, five-minute single-use link (login.tsx).
SSO view on the Business page offers Sign in with a password only when the Business password method is on; no Administrator sign-in link on the Business page (login.tsx group === 'legal' guards).
An address outside the allowed domains needs an existing active account to receive a link (instance.ts magicLinkDenied and user create hook); still true while at least one domain is listed.
Sign-in links already sent stop working when the Business magic-link method is off, including after the last domain is removed (instance.ts session create hook returns false on /magic-link/verify).
Sessions already held keep working after the list is emptied: the policy is checked only when a session is created (instance.ts session create hook).
Portal Contracts and Matters sections: documents-section.tsx now shows the Document type name and colour on a Version pill; the guide does not describe the pill, so no text changes.
router.tsx only adds /signing/return; session.ts only clears wizard drafts after sign-out.
limitations: V-C02 negative check 'unapproved domain gets the supported refusal/neutral response' still holds while at least one domain is listed. With an empty list the page shows Sign-in is unavailable instead of the sign-in link form; the walkthrough should test the empty-list state with an existing Business User and restore a domain and method afterwards.
Several-provider SSO on the Business page needs two identity providers and Business SSO on; the walkthrough may cover this only as far as the Email field and the unserved-domain message.
